camera: HeroCam0 / cam_arrival_hero — the founder's arrival composition
authority: HUMAN. Every criterion below is a structural property that can be measured. NONE of them is a claim about how close the frame is to the founder's reference image; that judgement is the founder's and no number here substitutes for it.
_how_targets_were_set: From the founder's written description of the reference, decomposed in
docs/relay/WONDERLAND_ART_DIRECTION.md, and NOT from the image itself —
the image is not in this repository. The palette bands in particular are a
FIRST PROPOSAL. They say 'pale stone dominant, pink and violet present,
gold as an accent, lush but not a forest', which is what the reference is
described as. If the founder looks at the frame and disagrees, the numbers
here are what should change — not the measurement.

_measured_at_2026_08_21.note: Two snapshots, so the direction of travel is visible. `before` is the frame as the L4 last streamed it; `after` is the same frame with the two framing boughs lifted and thinned. Nothing was deleted — the arch of foliage the composition is built on is still there, it just stopped roofing the shot.
_measured_at_2026_08_21.palette_note: The warm 20-65 degree hue band was originally one bucket and read 28.3%, which said gold dominates the frame. It does not: splitting bright saturated gold from dull warm timber and paving puts real gold at 13.6% (inside its accent band). The first number would have sent someone to de-gold a world that is not over-gold.

environment_density.why: The reference has no empty ground. A frame that is mostly floor reads as a level under construction however good the lighting is.

no_barren_ground.why: Bare ground plane with nothing on it is the single clearest tell of procedural placeholder.

sky_present.why: The reference names a bright lavender sky with soft cloud as an element. It measured 4.1% — GPU-READY-QUEUE.md called that a standing problem, 'four per cent is not a sky', with the top third 89.4% covered. Lifting and thinning the two framing boughs took it to 6.54%, and the top third from 10.6% to 17.8% sky. The remaining gap is held by the golden gate (9.5% of the top third) and the framing tree (8.0%) — BOTH of which the reference explicitly calls for, so closing it further means moving them rather than deleting foliage. That is a founder decision, not a threshold to quietly lower.

material_diversity.why: Rich material variation is in the founder's list. One stone and one green is what a graybox looks like.

layering.why: Foreground plaza / midground garden / distant city is the reference's whole structure. A frame that is all one depth band reads flat however dense it is.

placeholder_forms.why: Pixels carried by a lone cube, cylinder or sphere with almost no siblings. This is the 'random primitive spam' the founder named, made countable.

relay_dogs_readable.why: Canonical Relay Dogs must be visibly present at spawn. Readable means owning pixels after occlusion, tall enough to recognise, AND with the visor and gold eyes visible — the face is the identity.

hero_dog_scale.why: The arrival composition is built around the hero Dog. A Dog too small to read is not a subject.

palette_cream.why: The reference is pale cream and white stone before it is anything else. Measured at 8.29%, and 3.3 of those points are the Relay Dogs' own white coats — actual pale stone is nearer 5%. This is the largest remaining gap to the target look and it will not be closed by thinning foliage: it needs more pale stone architecture in frame, which is exactly what the Marble Royal Garden is for.

palette_pink.why: Pink and rose roofs, flowers and hearts are named throughout the reference.

palette_violet.why: Purple mushrooms, wisteria and the arcane circle. Currently 4.3%.

palette_gold_is_an_accent.why: Gold gates, keys and filigree are ACCENTS in the reference. Measured at 13.0% once bright saturated gold is separated from warm timber and paving — inside the band, so this is currently MET and the band exists to keep it that way.

foliage_not_dominant.why: Lush, not a forest. It measured 30.6% and was the largest colour in the frame — the two framing boughs' leaf cards alone were 22.2 of those points, roofing a shot whose reference is a pastel stone city seen THROUGH planting. Lifting and thinning them took green to 25.21%, which is 0.21 over. The remainder is the great trees' crowns; thinning those globally would touch every tree in the world, so it is left as a deliberate near-miss rather than a change made to clear a threshold.

warm_surfaces_not_dominant.why: Bark, warm paving and dull brass. Present in the reference but never the subject; a frame that is a fifth timber is reading as a woodland path rather than a palace approach.
